setup: CREATE TABLE filtered AS SELECT i, i%64 AS g, CASE WHEN i%10=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%100 END AS v, i%7 AS k, CASE WHEN i%4=0 THEN true WHEN i%4=1 THEN false ELSE NULL END AS keep FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: filtered_count_sum
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(keep), sum(v) FILTER(WHERE keep) FROM filtered

workloads.name: filtered_distinct_ordered_list
workloads.sql: SELECT list_extract(list(DISTINCT v ORDER BY v DESC) FILTER(keep AND v IS NOT NULL),1), list_extract(list(DISTINCT v ORDER BY v DESC) FILTER(WHERE keep AND v IS NOT NULL),20), count(DISTINCT v) FILTER(keep) FROM filtered

workloads.name: filtered_distinct_first_last_grouped
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(first_v),sum(last_v),sum(n) FROM (SELECT g,first(DISTINCT v ORDER BY v) FILTER(keep AND v IS NOT NULL) AS first_v,last(DISTINCT v ORDER BY v) FILTER(WHERE keep AND v IS NOT NULL) AS last_v,count(DISTINCT v) FILTER(keep) AS n FROM filtered GROUP BY g) q
